integrity_notes: The order-one fixed-rate cumulant is a known prior result and is not offered as new.
The uniform first-parameter derivative is the analytic premise needed for finite-time zero uniqueness.
Finite-time Kummer computations are checks, not proofs of uniform estimates.
scientific_limitations: The scientific contribution is restricted to a compact reset-rate interval, its unique sufficiently-late fourth-cumulant zero, and the moving log-scale profile.
No explicit earliest valid time, global all-rate uniqueness, or finite-sample inference result is established.
The underlying fixed-reset-rate fourth-cumulant constant and complete first two asymptotic coefficients were previously published.
The uniform-parameter corollary may be viewed as implicit in the earlier Kummer proof; priority remains a bounded-search judgment.
title: A uniform finite-time fourth-cumulant threshold for an active memory-reset particle
